company.description: In the research project smile future mobility was demonstrated: The combined use of public, collective and individual mobility services as an alternative to private cars, all in one app. As a logical next step, Wiener Stadtwerke founded the subsidiary "Upstream - next level mobility GmbH" at the beginning of 2016. To ensure the expansion and management of its own digital infrastructures, to expand the digital services and to strengthen the position as the central integrator and contact for networked urban transport.
